'''Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game''' is the 3rd Star Wars CCG product, published February 1996 by Decipher with Parker Brothers. It contains six exclusive white-border premium cards (3 Light, 3 Dark), two 60-card preconstructed white-border decks, a rules booklet, and one Premiere booster pack. MSRP $19.95. The first ~50,000 boxes had a Limited Premiere pack; later boxes had Unlimited. Europe used a Waddingtons flip-top box. Japanese version by Takara.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>
